defs.def: in a careless way; not arranged in an order 随便地；杂乱无章地

ex.s: It isn't common for children to have the same job as their parents anymore / anyhow.
ex.t: 孩子们不再有与父母相同的工作/无论如何，这是不常见的。

ex.s: "Living in a hotel means the hotel staff makes the bed every day and I don't have to do my own washing!Anyhow, 'm now looking fora remote house on the edge of the city." Read"DrummerHitstheRoad".Answerthequestions.
ex.t: 「住在酒店意味着酒店工作人员每天整理床铺，我不必自己洗！总之，我现在正在寻找一栋位于城市边缘的偏远房子。"阅读" DrummerHitstheRoad "。回答问题。

ex.s: Anyhow I couldn't arrest you myself, so I got a plain-clothes man to do the job.
ex.t: 不管怎么说，我自己不能逮捕你，所以我找了一个便衣人来做这项工作。
